I'm a PhD student in Health Economics and Policy in the Department of Health Policy and Management at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. I study **supply-side health policy**. Much of my work focuses on behavioral health and on licensing reform, especially interstate licensing. I'm also interested in injury prevention and health equity.

Before Hopkins, I was a pre-doctoral research professional at the University of Chicago's Development Innovation Lab and a research assistant at the Hamilton Project at the Brookings Institution. I'm affiliated with the Johns Hopkins Center for Mental Health and Addiction Policy and the Center for Gun Violence Solutions.

## Education

**PhD, Health Economics and Policy**, Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health, expected 2029 \
**BS, Mathematics; BA, Economics**, University of Chicago, 2022

## Interests

Supply-side health policy · health care labor markets · behavioral health · interstate licensing · injury prevention · health equity
